notes.title: Our latest cyberpunk visual novel released
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce our new cyberpunk visual novel Crystal Chameleon! :) You can find it at:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/989110/Crystal_Chameleon/
Meet Jackie - a freelance negotiator who's best friend is a cyber dolphin. Accompany her in an adventure she didn't really ask for. Solve a mystery and maybe make some new friends along the way.

notes.title: Crystal Chameleon, new cyberpunk visual novel production launch :)
notes.notes:
Dear friends :)

We have just launched the production of our next cyberpunk visual novel - Crystal Chameleon. You can find updates on the production & get in touch with us through Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/BunnyJessican]https://twitter.com/BunnyJessican[/url] or Facebook [url=https://www.facebook.com/crystalchameleongame/]https://www.facebook.com/crystalchameleongame/[/url]

Crystal Chameleon represents a step towards a more interactive gameplay and new visuals for Vysoko Anime Production. We want to tackle some of the issues we had with Invisible Apartment as well as using the best out of that series.

notes.title: Major update live! :) We brought all chapters together into one app.
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that you're now able to play all chapters of Invisible Apartment from the core game - chapter one. They're now available as DLCs and will show up in your game menu. No need to switch between games! :) This was our long term plan - to bring all chapters together into one game.

Together with this major update the DLCs have all discounts! Check them out together with the bundle at http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1766/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/543230/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/543220/
http://store.steampowered.com/app/532060/

Thank you very much for your support! ;)

Milan & Jeroen
Vysoko Anime Production

notes.title: Major update coming! :)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8040929/936e6214d1ea52d527723998ba057aa289806a89.jpg[/img]

We're working hard to finish up a major update to our software and the way how Invisible Apartment chapters are distributed. Up until now each part of Invisible Apartment was a separate app. This month we're introducing an update to Invisible Apartment 1, which will [b]enable you to switch between chapters within one app[/b].

The app will track which chapter you already purchased & make it available. There will be safe-slots per each chapter.

We hope you'll enjoy this update. It will consolidate the whole series putting everything together :)

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Invisible Apartment 3 Steam release coming soon
notes.notes: We're busy preparing the Steam release of Invisible Apartment 3 :) Afterwards we'll be looking at part 1 and tackling the issues that have been with the game from day one. A new IA1Rex will be released in which the texts will be edited by our editor Daniel Meyer & we'll revamp some of the routes to not have them be so linear. There will also be a couple of new illustrations. Stay tuned.

notes.title: Professional editing coming soon
notes.notes:
As part of the next stretch-goal in our  
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vysoko/invisible-apartment-3/posts/1549503]Kickstarter campaign[/url] we will be commissioning professional editing of the texts of Invisible Apartment 1. This was one of the major complains of this part of the series. With this we will bring the texts to the standard they're at in part 2 and part 3.

Our goal is that all parts of the series will be edited by a native english speaker and also that the texts will feel consistent.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vysoko/invisible-apartment-3/posts/1547348][img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/005/713/079/152db4931ce68f126a1cecd47068abcf_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1460620312&auto=format&q=92&s=0850f74b51406d93a38300b7bbcbc1dc[/img][/url]

notes.title: Linux update! & Extras now accessible from within the game!
notes.notes:
Hi All! ^_^ We have just made an update to the Linux & Windows versions of Invisible Apartment.

There are multiple threads in our discussion forums from people who run Linux - for example  http://steamcommunity.com/app/351790/discussions/0/617329505857190095/ - and the need to meet the dependencies of having the Qt libraries installed. The newest build has all libraries embedded, so this problem should be solved. Remember that we provide a 64bit version for Linux.

-

A change that concerns buyers of the "Invisible Apartment - Extras".

If you buy the Extras http://store.steampowered.com/app/353000/ , then you'll be able to access them from within the game's interface. This solves the problem of folks not finding the soundtrack, art-book and hi-res poster.
Once you restart the game you'll get a button on the main screen which looks like this - https://40.media.tumblr.com/17c6996785882bb0ff9d7e24c7dee50b/tumblr_nm86se7WT01tw34vwo1_1280.png
and one on the launch screen.

notes.title: Linux update & "Extras" in game integration soon
notes.notes:
We're finishing the preparations to publish a new Linux & Windows build. The Linux build will have some crucial changes & bugfixes. All necessary libraries are now built in, so you don't need to look at dependencies & then there are some bugfixes which were distribution specific. This should fix a LOT of things.

Another change we'll be publishing in the next days is that once you download the "Extras" you'll see a button on the screen next to the menu to access the artbook, soundtrack and poster which is part of the extras. You'll just restart the game and there it pops up. So here you have it - the DLC will be accessible from within the game. (the button will appear on the start-screen & on top of the main screen once you launch the game)

Stay tuned :)

notes.title: Extras HowTo & how they work (Invisible Apartment - Extras)
notes.notes:
We've received some comments on the "extras" DLC (Downloadable Content)
and that some people couldn't find the files (the soundtrack, artbook images and poster).

The description of the Extras says: "These are the extras - the soundtrack by Iede Saudek and Thomas Krze, the preliminary works by Camila "Bura" Gormaz http://www.bura.cl and a hi-def illustration by Lia Margot. After downloading the DLC, open up Invisible Apartment's folder to find the "extra" directory."

This is done at some other visual novels we've seen.

We recognize that some people couldn't find the files and so we made it our ToDo to link the DLC into the game. We're working on it being possible to access the files from the game. This functionality will be added soon.

If you have any questions than feel free to ask.

notes.title: Invisible Apartment 2 production started!
notes.notes:
[url=http://invisibleapartment.com/post/113695174097/production-of-invisible-apartment-2-has-begun][img]http://41.media.tumblr.com/0f6a1800400c3cefa6afda1ac57b11fb/tumblr_nl9ex8ng8l1tw34vwo1_1280.jpg[/img][/url]

Invisible Apartment 2 is an in-production sequel to the original Invisible Apartment and part of the cyberpunk visual novel series of the same name.

The Kickstarter campaign can be found here - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/921792122/invisible-apartment-2-visual-novel Please support us if you'd like the story to continue :)

It will be considerably longer than the first freemium part of the series which has been available on Steam. It will feature more characters, places, routes and a lot more dialogues.

We will take you deeper down the rabbit hole and show you more of Alex’s life and how he copes with the events from the end of the last chapter, Kacey’s fears and dilemmas and how they try to resolve more life threatening situations.

Can they play a game with the Central Intelligence the way they wanted to? How do they fight back? What is hidden in Kacey’s mind and how will it help them move forward?

Find out in the upcoming cyberpunk visual novel Invisible Apartment 2!

[url=invisibleapartment.com]invisibleapartment.com[/url]

-
